blockingFindings.title: R2 cache-decision callback preservation is untested
blockingFindings.rationale: R2 explicitly requires no-flow calls to preserve cache-decision callbacks; without executable coverage, an implementation could drop or bypass that callback and still pass these tests.
blockingFindings.issue: The R2 tests verify provider execution, thrown error behavior, and unchanged foreign flow/cache bytes, but no test installs or asserts a cache-decision callback during a no-flow call.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local no-flow test that passes the cache-decision callback option used by the target Agent API and asserts it is still invoked with the expected decision data while flow cache reads/writes and metrics remain skipped.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R2 explicitly requires no-flow calls to preserve cache-decision callbacks; without executable coverage, an implementation could drop or bypass that callback and still pass these tests.

blockingFindings.title: R3 does not verify start log null attribution
blockingFindings.rationale: R3 requires both start and end logs for no-flow calls to carry explicit null flow identity; an implementation could fix only end logging and still pass.
blockingFindings.issue: The R3 test checks the agent end entry and prompt context, but it never locates the agent start entry or asserts that start.spec, start.sentiPhase, and start.taskId are null.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Extend the R3 log test to assert the agent start entry retains the existing payload shape and has spec, sentiPhase, and taskId set to null.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R3 requires both start and end logs for no-flow calls to carry explicit null flow identity; an implementation could fix only end logging and still pass.

blockingFindings.title: R7 layout matrix omits failure and repeated-call R6 scenarios
blockingFindings.rationale: R7 explicitly requires the R6 byte-snapshot coverage to hold for each repository layout; the current tests leave critical layout-specific failure and cache-repeat paths uncovered.
blockingFindings.issue: The R7 matrix covers managed worktree, main single-flow, main multi-flow, and no-flow layouts, but each layout only performs one successful standalone call. It does not assert the R6 byte-snapshot invariant for provider failure or repeated equivalent calls in each layout.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: For each R7 repository layout, exercise standalone provider success, provider failure, and repeated equivalent calls, asserting the seeded flow/cache snapshots remain byte-identical after each scenario.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R7 explicitly requires the R6 byte-snapshot coverage to hold for each repository layout; the current tests leave critical layout-specific failure and cache-repeat paths uncovered.

blockingFindings.title: R8 core flow and cache-hit attribution are not covered
blockingFindings.rationale: R8 requires both existing core flow calls and existing cache-hit attribution to remain unchanged; regressions in either path would not be caught by the current test suite.
blockingFindings.issue: The R8 test only covers an explicit flow-hook agent call and verifies one invocation metric plus a cache write. It does not cover existing core flow agent calls, nor does it verify existing cache-hit attribution remains unchanged.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local tests for an existing core flow Agent.call path with ambient attribution and for a cache-hit path, asserting exactly one invocation metric per provider call and unchanged cache-hit attribution semantics.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R8 requires both existing core flow calls and existing cache-hit attribution to remain unchanged; regressions in either path would not be caught by the current test suite.

blockingFindings.title: No-flow layout is not actually no-flow
blockingFindings.rationale: R7 explicitly requires spec-local tests to construct a no-flow repository layout; the current artifact marks R7 covered, but the test does not exercise that layout.
blockingFindings.issue: The `no-flow` matrix case passes `activeCount: 0`, but `makeLayout` still creates one `specs/foreign-1/flow.json`, one `.senti/agent-cache/...` file, and one context because the loop uses `Math.max(activeCount, 1)`. With `withFlowManager: false`, this covers a repository with no flow manager but still seeded flow artifacts, not a no-flow repository layout.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Adjust the fixture or add a separate R7 case that constructs a repository layout with no active flow artifacts/contexts and verifies standalone calls do not create or mutate flow/cache state.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R7 explicitly requires spec-local tests to construct a no-flow repository layout; the current artifact marks R7 covered, but the test does not exercise that layout.

blockingFindings.title: R4 does not assert core-bound attribution cannot be overridden
blockingFindings.rationale: R4 specifically requires the plugin cannot override the core-bound attribution mode; the current R4 coverage omits that contract and the coverage artifact incorrectly marks it covered.
blockingFindings.issue: The R4 test records delegated `resolve` and `call` options but only asserts command namespacing plus provider/profile precedence. It never asserts that delegated options include the core-bound no-flow attribution after plugin/user options, so an implementation could pass this test while allowing plugin-supplied `flowAttribution` to override the core binding.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add an assertion in the R4 delegate test that both delegated `resolve` and `call` receive the enforced no-flow attribution even when caller options attempt to supply a different attribution mode.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R4 specifically requires the plugin cannot override the core-bound attribution mode; the current R4 coverage omits that contract and the coverage artifact incorrectly marks it covered.

requirements.desc: Agent calls support a validated attribution mode whose default preserves ambient behavior and whose no-flow mode performs no flow-context resolution for prompt-cache or metrics.

A no-flow call skips flow-scoped cache reads, cache writes, cache-hit metrics, success metrics, and failure metrics while preserving provider execution, return text, thrown errors, and cache-decision callbacks.
Agent start/end logs for a no-flow call retain the existing log files and payload shape but set spec, sentiPhase, and taskId to null without resolving an ambient flow.

createPluginAgentApi delegates resolve and call with existing plugin commandId namespacing and provider/profile configuration precedence, and applies a core-bound attribution mode after plugin-supplied options so the plugin cannot override it.

dispatchPluginCommand supplies the standalone plugin context through createPluginAgentApi bound to no-flow attribution, while runFlowCommandHooks retains ambient attribution without plugin-name or workflow-command special cases.

Spec-local tests snapshot every seeded foreign specs/*/flow.json file and active-flow .senti/agent-cache file before and after standalone provider success, provider failure, and repeated equivalent calls, and assert byte-identical content.

Spec-local tests construct an active managed worktree layout, main repository layouts with one and multiple active flows, and a no-flow repository layout, then assert the R6 byte snapshots remain equal for each layout.

Existing core flow agent calls and explicit flow-hook agent calls retain ambient cache attribution and exactly one invocation metric for each provider call; existing cache-hit attribution remains unchanged.
